text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer accompanies Daiichi Ruby to 
her estate, where they suddenly find 
themselves face-to-face with her mother, 
known as a legendary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Intimidated by the sheer presence of a 
mother who seemed to see right through 
them, the Trainer felt small. Even so, 
wanting to be worthy of managing her, they 
puffed out their chest with pride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping the Trainer will help find her 
daughter's brightest radiance, the mother 
entrusts her to them. She also shows 
concern regarding a schedule focused on 
her daughter's physical development.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the academy, Daiichi 
Ruby spoke of her mother's racing 
days—describing her as truly magnificent. 
In that moment, the Trainer caught a 
fleeting sparkle in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reason she desired the Triple Tiara 
route... The Trainer sensed it wasn't just 
to follow in her clan's footsteps, but 
also born from a deep longing for her 
mother.
